## Symptom

What you expected the API/UI to return or show, and what it actually returned or showed instead.

## Root Cause

Why it happens — fill in once diagnosed; leave blank if filing before investigating.

## Fix

What was changed to resolve it — fill in once fixed.

## Fixed In

Commit SHA and short summary, filled in after merge — this is what makes the issue a searchable record linking the symptom to the fix, not just a diagnosis.
